name: Party rentals

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Party table package
services.story: The main story: a $140 party table package (6 tables, 40 chairs) picked up at Lee Party Supply. A $40 deposit when booking, the $100 rest at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Popcorn machine
services.story: A $35 popcorn machine for the weekend. A card is saved for the store's $20 late-cancel or no-show fee. Alex pays at the counter.

services.name: Chocolate fountain
services.story: A $55 chocolate fountain, paid in full when booking.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Backyard party order
services.story: The main story: a backyard party order from the list: a castle bounce house, a 20x20 tent, 5 tables and 40 chairs, with $60 delivery: $640. A $160 deposit when booking; the $480 rest is charged to the saved card when Derek marks the job done.

services.name: Small table and chair order
services.story: A small order under $200: 5 tables and 12 chairs, delivered, $150, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Large tent event
services.story: A large tent on a sloped yard, quoted from Alex's yard photos at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Alex signs the quote; a $160 deposit when booking, and the $480 rest on the saved card at DONE.

questions_before_times: The party's date and hours, and the town or ZIP (for the delivery fee)
The items and how many, picked from the list
The ground: grass, concrete, a deck or other
A flat space for each item, and its size
An outdoor outlet within 100 feet, or the generator
For a tent: how far from the house, open or closed sides
safety_stop: Someone hurt or not breathing, or an inflatable lifting or blowing over right now
A downed power line, or a tent touching a power line
license: No state license for renting party equipment in most places. The business registration where the state asks for one: from the state form.
